fusions.name: Wringing Grip
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: a crushing grip deals 9 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Fixed Bearing
fusions.desc: Sends a shriek that deals 30 resonating damage. Every hit is a critical hit, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Open Palm
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Clean Catch
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
